caught_by: gates.cjs barrier runs the whole tier at the candidate tree and compares every suite with the same tier at base: a suite red at the candidate and not red by the same assertions at base is newly_red, the tier fails (assertion) and the barrier is red, exit 1. A suite red by the same assertions at base is carried, and one that passes its single rerun is flaky; both are listed, never hidden
missed_by: QA chose its suites by name pattern, and the narrowed run was green while the whole tier was red
